edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner directly from msg.sender
constructor writes the caller-controlled msg.sender into owner
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner
caller-supplied _newOwner flows into the ownership handover
transferOwnership writes _newOwner into newOwner
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0)
constructor initialises symbol
constructor initialises name
constructor initialises decimals
constructor sets _totalSupply to the initial minted amount
constructor credits the whole supply to a fixed address in balances
totalSupply returns _totalSupply
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the ledger
balanceOf reads the balances mapping
balanceOf indexes balances with the caller-supplied tokenOwner
transfer debits balances[msg.sender]
transfer writes both the sender and recipient balances
transfer credits the user-supplied destination address
transfer applies the user-supplied amount to the balances
transfer delegates the debit to safeSub for underflow protection
transfer delegates the credit to safeAdd for overflow protection
approve keys the allowance map by msg.sender
approve overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender] without checking the old value
approve stores the caller-supplied spender
approve stores the caller-supplied allowance amount
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender]
transferFrom moves balances from an arbitrary from address
transferFrom reduces the stored allowance in the allowed mapping
transferFrom uses the caller-supplied from address as the debit source
transferFrom uses the caller-supplied to address as the credit target
transferFrom applies the caller-supplied amount
transferFrom delegates the balance/allowance debits to safeSub
transferFrom delegates the credit to safeAdd
allowance reads the allowed mapping
allowance indexes allowed with tokenOwner
allowance indexes allowed with spender
approveAndCall keys the allowance map by msg.sender
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call
approveAndCall forwards the caller-supplied spender into the external call
approveAndCall forwards the caller-supplied token amount
approveAndCall forwards arbitrary calldata to receiveApproval
approveAndCall performs an external call into the untrusted spender contract after updating state
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender
transferAnyERC20Token forwards tokens to the privileged owner and reads owner as the guard
transferAnyERC20Token calls transfer on an arbitrary, owner-supplied token contract
transferAnyERC20Token uses the caller-supplied token contract address
transferAnyERC20Token uses the caller-supplied token amount
safeAdd stores the checked sum a + b in local c
safeSub stores the checked difference a - b in local c
safeMul stores the checked product a * b in local c
safeDiv stores the guarded quotient a / b in local c
